interactions.note: The epitope of dAb3 on RBR HOIP of E3 ubiquitin ligase was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. Apo dAb3 crystallized as a dimer and its structure revealed that the dimer interface is similar to the interface between VH and VK of a conventional antibody. Two dAb3 molecules bind to the antigen and contribute different residues toward interactions with the IBR domain of HOIP.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.25 angstroms

The epitope of dAb3 on RBR HOIP of E3 ubiquitin ligase was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The HOIP inhibitor compound 4 was soaked into the crystals. Apo dAb3 crystallized as a dimer and its structure revealed that the dimer interface is similar to the interface between VH and VK of a conventional antibody. Two dAb3 molecules bind to the antigen and contribute different residues toward interactions with the IBR domain of HOIP.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.106 angstroms
